snippet.title: Fire Emblem Shadows - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Official Fire Emblem Shadows website: https://shadows.nintendo.com/
Download here:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/6746113513
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nintendo.zaha
